_meta.description: Calibration corpus for AI music detection. Human and AI tracks with expected verdicts.

verdict_bands.EHER MENSCHLICH: Score 0.21-0.40: Track is likely human but has minor anomalies.
verdict_bands.LIKELY AI-ASSISTED: Score 0.61-0.80: Strong indicators of AI involvement.

_meta.purpose: Used to validate scoring thresholds and calibrate detector sensitivity.

tracks.title: One More Time
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Classic 2000 French house production. Heavily processed vocals with intentional rhythmic gating, sidechain compression, and layered disco samples. Production choices reflect deliberate artistic intent with human timing variations throughout.

tracks.title: Strobe
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: 10-minute progressive house arrangement with complex evolving structure, multiple breakdowns, and organic filter sweeps. Arrangement choices show human musical decision-making with non-repeating structural development.

tracks.title: Windowlicker
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: IDM track with extreme dynamic range, natural tempo drift, and complex polyrhythmic programming. Contains deliberate imperfections and analog warmth characteristic of hardware-based production.

tracks.title: Dayvan Cowboy
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Organic textures with tape saturation, subtle pitch warble, and layered field recordings. Production exhibits natural warmth and analog character that AI models struggle to replicate authentically.

tracks.title: Open Eye Signal
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Dense, detailed techno production with intricate percussive layers, analog synth processing, and organic reverb tails. Complex signal chain processing shows human sound design expertise.

tracks.title: Can't Do Without You
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Vocal-driven electronic track with natural vocal processing, organic filtering, and human timing. Vocal performance contains natural breath and emotional dynamics absent from AI vocals.

tracks.title: Parallel Jalebi
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Organic-electronic hybrid with field recordings, hand percussion, and non-standard time signatures. Experimental arrangement reflects human creative choices rather than pattern generation.

tracks.title: Archangel
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Dubstep/garage hybrid with vinyl crackle, fragmented vocal samples, and irregular rhythmic patterns. Lo-fi production aesthetic with deliberate noise artifacts and humanized swing.

tracks.filename: Nicolas Jaar - Space Is Only Noise.mp3
tracks.title: Space Is Only Noise
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Experimental ambient composition with extensive use of silence, irregular structures, and live instrument recordings. Unconventional arrangement demonstrates human artistic decision-making.

tracks.title: Song of Los
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Organic-electronic fusion with live instrument integration, complex dynamic arrangements, and natural reverb spaces. Production exhibits human attention to emotional arc and pacing.

tracks.title: Bad Kingdom
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Collaborative electronic track with layered production, vocal processing, and complex arrangement transitions. Three producers contributing distinct creative voices creates non-repeating structural complexity.

tracks.title: Emerald Rush
tracks.label: human
tracks.notes: Extended progressive arrangement with evolving textures, dynamic builds, and organic synthesis. Production demonstrates human understanding of tension and release across long timeframes.

tracks.title: Freedom
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Documented Suno AI generation. Exhibits typical AI artifacts: overly consistent harmonic structure, generic vocal processing, and formulaic arrangement without unique creative choices.

tracks.title: Synthetic Dreams
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Fully AI-generated artist. Vocal timbre lacks natural breath and emotional variation. Harmonic progressions follow predictable patterns typical of generative music models.

tracks.title: Digital Mirage
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Spotify-listed AI band. Production exhibits uniform spectral balance, synthetic reverb characteristics, and algorithmic arrangement patterns. No evidence of human performance or artistic choice.

tracks.title: Upbeat Electronic
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Suno showcase track. Clean but generic production with typical AI hallmarks: overly polished dynamics, formulaic drops, and lack of genre-specific imperfections that define authentic styles.

tracks.title: Ambient Journey
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Udio showcase track. Ambient generation with recognizable AI characteristics: uniform spatial processing, lack of organic texture variation, and synthetic-sounding reverb tails.

tracks.title: Cosmic Drift
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Generated on Boomy AI music platform. Simple harmonic structure, generic sound palette, and algorithmic arrangement typical of early-generation AI music tools.

tracks.title: Corporate Energy
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: AI-generated stock music from Soundraw. Designed for background use with intentionally generic characteristics, loop-based structure, and algorithmic transitions between sections.

tracks.title: Sonata in D Minor
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: AI classical composition. While technically proficient, exhibits computational precision in timing and dynamics that differs from human interpretation. Note velocity patterns follow mathematical distributions rather than expressive phrasing.

tracks.title: Ambient Flow
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: AI generative ambient from Mubert. Seamless loop generation with characteristic uniformity in spatial placement, lack of organic noise floor, and algorithmic textural layering.

tracks.title: Generated Track
tracks.label: ai
tracks.notes: Generated on Loudly AI music platform. Typical stock-quality output with overly clean production, generic arrangement, and lack of the subtle imperfections found in human recordings.
